cover.house: Hardi Plank siding and a new roof cover this East End bungalow, with a new driveway running down the side of the lot to the back of the fenced yard. Wood-look floors run through the main living areas, from the Living Room through the Dining Area to an open Kitchen with a peninsula.
cover.house2: Behind the walls are new wiring with a new breaker box, three-phase power and new plumbing, and the laundry is inside the house. The Primary Bedroom sits at the back, under the only vaulted ceiling in the home.

items.title: Front Porch
items.body: Three steps lead up to the covered porch and the Craftsman-style front door, with board and batten detail in the gable above and a wide concrete walk to the street.

items.title: Front Entry
items.body: The front door has a divided-light window and opens right into the Living Room, with the Kitchen and the Dining Area just beyond.

left.kicker: Inside · The plan and the dining details
left.title: The Plan, with Dining Details

photos.title: Dining Area
photos.body: Beside the breakfast bar, under a sputnik-style light fixture, with the Living Room a few steps away and the pantry and Breakfast Nook around the corner.

photos.title: Breakfast Nook
photos.body: At the back of the Kitchen, with a large double-pane window and a door to the backyard deck, where steps lead down to the yard and the covered garage beyond.

photos.title: Breakfast Bar
photos.body: Two pendant lights hang over the stone-look counter of the peninsula, which adds seating and prep space between the Kitchen and the Dining Area.

notes: The front door opens into the Living Room, and a wide cased opening joins it to the Dining Area and the Kitchen, so the front of the house is one connected run. The pantry and the Breakfast Nook sit behind the Kitchen, and the nook opens to the backyard deck.

A hall leads from the Dining Area to the Primary Bedroom at the back and to Bedrooms 2 and 3, which share the hall bath. The covered garage and the open patio stand side by side at the back of the lot.

photos.title: Primary Bedroom
photos.body: The only vaulted ceiling in the home, with an exposed painted beam, sits over this rear bedroom, which has windows on two walls and a double-door closet.

photos.title: Primary Bath
photos.body: Double sinks sit in a marble-look top on a navy vanity under an LED backlit mirror, with a walk-in shower beside it and a high transom window for daylight with privacy.

photos.title: Hall Bath
photos.body: A tub with a full-height marble-look tile surround and a window above it, marble-look tile floors and a wide integrated sink, shared by Bedrooms 2 and 3 and used as the guest bath.

photos.title: Primary Closet
photos.body: Double doors open to a built-in shelving tower with hanging rods on both sides and more shelves above, with carpet carrying in from the bedroom. The built-ins stay with the home.

photos.title: Bedroom 2
photos.body: In the front corner of the house, with windows on two walls that look out to the neighborhood, a closet and carpet underfoot, steps from the Living Room and the hall bath.

photos.title: Bedroom 3
photos.body: The closet and the door are on the hall side, so the window wall stays open for a desk or a dresser. The hall bath is a few steps along the hall, next to the Primary Bedroom.

photos.title: Living Room
photos.body: A tall double-pane window faces the street, and a long clerestory window set high on the wall adds light with privacy. A wide cased opening leads on to the Dining Area.

photos.title: Kitchen
photos.body: Set up in an L with a peninsula, navy lower cabinets, white shaker-style uppers and stone-look counters, with stainless steel appliances and a range under a chimney hood.

photos.title: Covered Garage and Patio
photos.body: Heavy wood posts and a solid roof cover the garage, which has a concrete floor and a wood plank back wall. An open concrete patio, 8'11" x 25'11", sits alongside, in the fenced yard.

photos.title: Pantry
photos.body: Tucked just off the Kitchen at its back corner, with the Dining Area and the Living Room in view down the length of the house to the front door, a few steps from the Breakfast Nook.
